description:
Marks an open incident as acknowledged and attaches an AI diagnostic note. Use this tool when you have reviewed an active incident and want to let the team know it is being investigated.

Note: This tool does not resolve the incident, it only acknowledges it.

id.description:
Purpose: The unique ID of the incident to acknowledge.

Accepted values: Integer ID.

note.description:
Purpose: Optional note or investigation summary.

Example values:
Investigating 502 Bad Gateway error on origin server
Checking database CPU metrics

name: acknowledge_incident
